sources.text: in performing my duties in the inspection of the exhibits of white schools i was in every case treated with respect and at the close of our labours i parted from my associates with regret
and looked very angry and excessively disturbed for he knew that in accordance with his kingly promise
had spasms of bravery when well surrounded by the machinery of law and order
